newsitem.title: MALAWI: Malawi fortnightly T-Bill rate drops to 18.36 pct.
newsitem.headline: Malawi fortnightly T-Bill rate drops to 18.36 pct.

text.p: The average discount rate for Malawi's three-month Treasury Bills dropped by 80 basis points to 18.36 percent at the latest fortnightly tender from 19.16 percent two weeks ago, the Reserve Bank said on Tuesday.
Applications for 212.89 million kwacha of bills on offer totalled 122.17 million kwacha at an average price of 96.01 kwacha percent.

The average rate for six-month bills dropped to 18.94 percent from 19.51 percent two weeks ago. Applications for 224.72 million kwacha of bills on offer totalled 134.10 million kwacha at the average price of 90.88 kwacha percent.

For nine-month bills, the average rate dropped to 19.13 from 20.18 two weeks ago. Applications for 186.99 million kwacha of bills on offer totalled 140.06 million kwacha at the average price of 86.04 kwacha percent.
